method: semi-supervised: masked-reconstruction pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, then Mean Teacher consistency on the unlabelled machines (Tarvainen & Valpola, NeurIPS 2017)

model.type: channel-independent causal temporal CNN (4 dilated Conv1d, residual) + MLP heads
model.heads: remaining useful life + health class, for the component given

limits: trained and tested on simulated machines whose wear laws were written by hand (month.py): it shows the semi-supervised method and the deployment path, not the accuracy on the real cell
